source: calibrateMultidimensional by MH-RM with Hessian standard errors on data sets of 800 persons simulated with createRandom(seed) from the mean of mirt's MH-RM over seeds 1 to 10 on psych::bfi's 25 graded items and 5 correlated dimensions. The empirical standard error of an estimate is its standard deviation over the data sets, less the variance of MH-RM over seeds 1 to 10 on data set 1.
